Example: پولیس نے جرم کے ثبوت فراہم کیے۔

Translation: The police provided proof of the crime.

Root Word: Arabic 'thubūt' + 'farāham'.

Synonyms: دلیل دینا, شہادت پیش کرنا

Translations:
EN: to be proven guilty / to be convicted / for a crime to be established

FR: être reconnu coupable / être convaincu de crime

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the result where the court decides that the person actually committed the crime based on evidence.

Example: عدالت میں اس کا جرم ثابت ہو گیا۔

Translation: His crime was proven (he was found guilty) in court.

Root Word: Arabic 'jurm' + 'thābit'.

Synonyms: قصور وار ٹھہرنا, مجرم قرار پانا

Translations:
EN: to announce a sentence / to condemn / to pass judgment
AR: نَطَقَ بِالعُقُوبَة
FR: prononcer une peine / condamner

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb specifically referring to a judge telling the convicted person what their punishment will be.

Example: جج نے اسے عمر قید کی سزا سنائی۔

Translation: The judge announced (delivered) a life imprisonment sentence to him.

Root Word: Arabic 'sazā' + Urdu 'sunānā'.

Synonyms: حکمِ سزا دینا

Translations:
EN: to imprison / to jail / to confine
AR: حَبَسَ / سَجَنَ
FR: emprisonner / incarcérer

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of putting someone behind bars or restricting their physical freedom.

Example: باغیوں کو قلعے میں قید کر دیا گیا۔

Translation: The rebels were imprisoned in the fort.

Root Word: Arabic 'qaid'.

Synonyms: جیل بھیجنا, محبوس کرنا

Translations:
EN: to release / to set free / to liberate / to acquit
AR: أَطْلَقَ سَرَاح / حَرَّرَ
FR: libérer / relâcher / élargir

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of letting someone go from jail or captivity.

Example: بے گناہ ثابت ہونے پر اسے رہا کر دیا گیا۔

Translation: He was released (set free) upon being proven innocent.

Root Word: Arabic 'rihā'.

Synonyms: آزاد کرنا, چھوڑنا

Translations:
EN: to gain acquittal / to be exonerated / to be cleared of charges
AR: نَالَ البَرَاءَة
FR: obtenir un acquittement / être blanchi

Definition:
(EN) Formal compound verb expressing the successful outcome of being officially declared innocent by the court.

Example: اس نے بڑی مشکل سے بریت حاصل کی۔

Translation: He gained acquittal (was cleared) with great difficulty.

Root Word: Arabic 'bariyyat' (innocence/acquittal).

Synonyms: بے گناہ ثابت ہونا, پاک صاف نکلنا

Translations:
EN: to appeal (legal) / to request a higher court / to plead
AR: اِسْتَأْنَفَ (قَانُونِيًّا) / نَاشَدَ
FR: faire appel / interjeter appel

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of asking a higher court to change the decision of a lower court.

Example: اس نے ہائی کورٹ میں اپیل کی ہے۔

Translation: He has made an appeal in the High Court.

Root Word: English 'appeal' + Urdu 'karnā'.

Synonyms: نظرِ ثانی کی درخواست کرنا, دہائی دینا

Translations:
EN: to elect / to choose / to select
AR: اِنْتَخَبَ / اِخْتَارَ
FR: élire / choisir / sélectionner

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of choosing a person for an office by vote or selecting an item from a group.

Translation: The people elected (chose) their representative.

Root Word: Arabic 'intikhāb'.

Synonyms: چننا, منتخب کرنا

EN: to vote / to cast a ballot
AR: أَدْلَى بِصَوْتِه

(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of giving one's formal choice in an election.

Example: اپنا ووٹ سوچ سمجھ کر دینا۔

Root Word: English 'vote' + Urdu 'denā'.

Synonyms: رائے دہی کرنا

EN: to run an election campaign / to canvass

FR: mener une campagne électorale

(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of organized activity to persuade voters to vote for a specific candidate.

Example: امیدوار پورے حلقے میں انتخابی مہم چلا رہا ہے۔

Root Word: Arabic 'intikhābī' + 'muhim'.

Synonyms: ووٹ مانگنا

Translations:
EN: to rig (election) / to cheat / to commit fraud / to be unfair

(EN) Compound verb expressing illegal or unfair manipulation of a process, especially an election, to get a desired result.

Root Word: Urdu 'dhāndlī'.

Synonyms: ہیرا پھیری کرنا, جعل سازی کرنا

EN: to be elected / to be chosen / to be selected
AR: اِخْتِيرَ / اِنْتُخِبَ
FR: être élu / être choisi

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the state of having been successfully chosen by a group or through a process.

Example: وہ بھاری اکثریت سے منتخب ہوا۔

Translation: He was elected with a heavy majority.

Root Word: Arabic 'muntaikhab'.

Synonyms: چنا جانا, کامیاب ہونا

Translations:
EN: to take an oath (office) / to be sworn in
AR: أَدَّى القَسَم
FR: prêter serment / être assermenté

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb specifically referring to an official taking a formal oath before starting their duties.

Example: نئے وزیرِ اعظم نے آج حلف اٹھایا۔

Translation: The new Prime Minister took the oath (was sworn in) today.

Root Word: Arabic 'ḥalf' + Urdu 'uṭhānā'.

Synonyms: قسم کھانا, عہد لینا

EN: to take charge of a ministry / to become a minister

FR: prendre la direction d'un ministère / devenir ministre

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of officially starting work as a government minister.

Example: اس نے تعلیم کی وزارت سنبھالی۔

Translation: He took charge of (became the minister for) Education.

Root Word: Arabic 'wizārat' + Urdu 'sambhālnā'.

Synonyms: عہدہ سنبھالنا

Translations:
EN: to resign / to quit / to step down
AR: اِسْتَقَالَ

(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of officially giving up a job or office.

Example: وزیر نے اپنے عہدے سے استعفیٰ دے دیا۔

Translation: The minister resigned from his post.

Root Word: Arabic 'istiʿfa'.

Synonyms: نوکری چھوڑنا, دستبردار ہونا

Translations:
EN: to suspend (official/service) / to put on hold

FR: suspendre

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb meaning to temporarily stop someone from working or to stop a service/process.

Example: بدعنوانی پر افسر کو معطل کر دیا گیا۔

Translation: The officer was suspended for corruption.

Root Word: Arabic 'muʿat̤t̤al'.

Synonyms: فارغ کرنا (عارضی طور پر), روک دینا

Translations:
EN: to dismiss / to fire (official) / to remove from post
AR: عَزَلَ / أَقَالَ
FR: licencier / limoger / destituer

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb meaning to permanently remove someone from their job or official position.

Example: ملازم کو بدتمیزی پر برطرف کر دیا گیا۔

Translation: The employee was dismissed (fired) for misbehavior.

Root Word: Persian 'bart̤araf'.

Synonyms: نکال دینا, موقوف کرنا

Translations:
EN: to restore / to reinstate / to revive / to bring back
AR: أَعَادَ / اِسْتَرَدَّ
FR: rétablir / restaurer / réintégrer

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of returning someone to their post or returning a system to its previous state.

Example: عدالت نے معطل افسر کو بحال کر دیا۔

Translation: The court reinstated (restored) the suspended officer.

Root Word: Arabic 'baḥāl'.

Synonyms: دوبارہ قائم کرنا, درست کرنا

Translations:
EN: to criticize / to critique / to find fault
AR: اِنْتَقَدَ
FR: critiquer

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of pointing out flaws or giving an evaluation of someone's work or policy.

Example: حکومت کی معاشی پالیسی پر تنقید کی گئی۔

Translation: The government's economic policy was criticized.

Root Word: Arabic 'tanqeed'.

Synonyms: نکتہ چینی کرنا, اعتراض کرنا

Translations:
EN: to oppose / to disagree / to resist
AR: عَارَضَ / نَاهَضَ
FR: s'opposer à / contester

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of going against an idea, person, or group.

Example: اپوزیشن نے نئے قانون کی مخالفت کی۔

Translation: The opposition opposed the new law.

Root Word: Arabic 'mukhalifat'.

Synonyms: خلاف ہونا, روڑے اٹکانا

Translations:
EN: to support / to back / to favor / to protect
AR: دَعَمَ / سَانَدَ
FR: soutenir / appuyer / favoriser

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of helping or agreeing with a person/cause.

Example: میں سچ کی حمایت کروں گا۔

Translation: I will support the truth.

Root Word: Arabic 'ḥimāyat'.

Synonyms: ساتھ دینا, مدد کرنا

Translations:
EN: to endorse / to second / to confirm / to support (formal)
AR: أَيَّدَ
FR: endosser / appuyer / confirmer (formel)

Definition:
(EN) Formal compound verb meaning to support a statement or proposal made by someone else.

Example: میں آپ کی تجویز کی تائید کرتا ہوں۔

Translation: I endorse (second) your proposal.

Root Word: Arabic 'tāʾeed'.

Synonyms: تصدیق کرنا, حمایت کرنا

Translations:
EN: to consult / to seek advice / to deliberate
AR: اِسْتَشَارَ / شَاوَرَ
FR: consulter / demander conseil

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of talking to someone to get their opinion or guidance before making a decision.

Example: کوئی بھی قدم اٹھانے سے پہلے والدین سے مشورہ کرو۔

Translation: Consult with (seek advice from) parents before taking any step.

Root Word: Arabic 'mashwara'.

Synonyms: رائے لینا, صلاح مشورہ کرنا

Translations:
EN: to agree / to coincide / to happen by chance
AR: اِتَّفَقَ / وَافَقَ
FR: être d'accord / coïncider

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of having the same opinion as someone else or two events happening at the same time.

Example: میں آپ کی بات سے مکمل اتفاق کرتا ہوں۔

Translation: I completely agree with what you say.

Root Word: Arabic 'ittifāq'.

Synonyms: ہمنوا ہونا, مان لینا

Translations:
EN: to disagree / to differ / to have a dispute
AR: اِخْتَلَفَ / تَعَارَضَ
FR: être en désaccord / différer

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of having a different opinion or being in conflict with a statement or person.

Example: جمہوریت میں اختلاف کرنے کا حق سب کو ہے۔

Translation: Everyone has the right to disagree in a democracy.

Root Word: Arabic 'ikhtilāf'.

Synonyms: اختلافِ رائے رکھنا, خلاف ہونا

Translations:
EN: to compromise / to make a deal / to reach an understanding
AR: سَاوَمَ / تَصَالَحَ / قَدَّمَ تَنَازُلات
FR: faire un compromis / passer un accord

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of settling a dispute by each side giving up something.

Example: اس نے اپنے اصولوں پر کبھی سمجھوتہ نہیں کیا۔

Translation: He never compromised on his principles.

Root Word: Hindi/Urdu 'samajh' + 'autā'.

Synonyms: صلح کرنا, ڈیل کرنا

Translations:
EN: to reconcile / to make peace / to arbitrate
AR: صَالَحَ / صَالَحَ بَيْنَ
FR: se réconcilier / faire la paix

Definition:
(EN) Formal compound verb expressing the act of ending a quarrel or helping two parties reach a peaceful resolution.

Example: دونوں خاندانوں کے درمیان مصالحت ہو گئی۔

Translation: Reconciliation took place (reconciled) between both families.

Root Word: Arabic 'muṣāliḥat'.

Synonyms: صلح صفائی کرنا, بیچ بچاؤ کرانا

Translations:
EN: to wage war / to fight / to battle
AR: حَارَبَ / قَاتَلَ
FR: faire la guerre / combattre

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of engaging in an organized armed conflict between nations or groups.

Example: حق کی خاطر جنگ کرنا عین عبادت ہے۔

Translation: To wage war (fight) for the sake of truth is exactly like worship.

Root Word: Persian 'jang' + Urdu 'karnā'.

Synonyms: لڑائی کرنا, معرکہ آرائی کرنا

Translations:
EN: to attack / to assault / to raid
AR: هَجَمَ / اِعْتَدَى
FR: attaquer / assaillir

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of starting a violent action against someone or something suddenly.

Example: شیر نے ہرن پر حملہ کر دیا۔

Translation: The lion attacked the deer.

Root Word: Arabic 'ḥamla'.

Synonyms: چڑھائی کرنا, وار کرنا

Translations:
EN: to defend / to protect / to stand up for
AR: دَافَعَ / حَمَى
FR: défendre / protéger

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of protecting oneself or others from an attack or accusation.

Example: ملک کا دفاع کرنا ہر شہری کا فرض ہے۔

Translation: To defend the country is the duty of every citizen.

Root Word: Arabic 'difāʿ'.

Synonyms: حفاظت کرنا, بچاؤ کرنا

Translations:
EN: to defeat / to beat / to conquer
AR: هَزَمَ / قَهَرَ
FR: vaincre / battre / défaire

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of winning a battle or competition against someone.

Example: ہماری ٹیم نے مخالف کو شکست دی۔

Translation: Our team defeated the opponent.

Root Word: Persian 'shikast' + Urdu 'denā'.

Synonyms: ہرانا, مات دینا

Translations:
EN: to suffer defeat / to be beaten / to lose
AR: اِنْهَزَمَ / خَسِرَ
FR: être vaincu / subir une défaite

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the state of losing a battle or being beaten by an opponent.

Example: دشمن نے میدان میں شکست کھائی۔

Translation: The enemy suffered defeat in the field.

Root Word: Persian 'shikast' + Urdu 'khānā'.

Synonyms: ہار جانا, پسپا ہونا

Translations:
EN: to gain victory / to conquer / to triumph
AR: اِنْتَصَرَ / فَتَحَ
FR: remporter la victoire / triompher

Definition:
(EN) Formal compound verb expressing the act of successfully winning a war or a major achievement.

Example: مسلمانوں نے مکہ پر فتح حاصل کی۔

Translation: The Muslims gained victory over (conquered) Mecca.

Root Word: Arabic 'fataḥ' + Urdu 'ḥāṣil karnā'.

Synonyms: جیتنا, غالب آنا

Translations:
EN: to occupy / to seize / to take control / to capture
AR: اِحْتَلَّ / اِسْتَوْلَى / قَبَضَ عَلَى
FR: occuper / saisir / s'emparer de

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of taking physical control of a place, property, or person by force or authority.

Example: فوج نے شہر پر قبضہ کر لیا۔

Translation: The army occupied (seized control of) the city.

Root Word: Arabic 'qabẓa'.

Synonyms: ہتھیانا, تسلط قائم کرنا

Translations:
EN: to besiege / to surround / to blockade
AR: حَاصَرَ
FR: assiéger / encercler

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of surrounding a place with an army to force it to surrender.

Example: قلعے کا کئی ماہ تک محاصرہ رہا۔

Translation: The fort remained besieged for many months.

Root Word: Arabic 'muḥāṣara'.

Synonyms: گھیرا ڈالنا, ناکہ بندی کرنا

Translations:
EN: to bomb / to bombard / to shell
AR: قَصَفَ
FR: bombarder / pilonner

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of attacking a place with bombs or heavy artillery.

Example: طیاروں نے سرحد پر بمباری کی۔

Translation: The planes bombed (bombarded) the border.

Root Word: English 'bomb' + Persian 'bārī' + Urdu 'karnā'.

Synonyms: گولہ باری کرنا

Translations:
EN: to fire (a weapon) / to shoot / to discharge a firearm
AR: أَطْلَقَ النَّار
FR: tirer (une arme) / faire feu

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of shooting bullets from a gun or pistol.

Example: نامعلوم افراد نے پولیس پر فائرنگ کی۔

Translation: Unknown persons fired (shot) at the police.

Root Word: English 'firing' + Urdu 'karnā'.

Synonyms: گولی چلانا

Translations:
EN: to be hit by a bullet / to be shot
AR: أُصِيبَ بِرَصَاصَة
FR: être touché par une balle / être blessé par balle

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the state of a bullet hitting a person or animal.

Example: اسے کندھے پر گولی لگی۔

Translation: He was hit by a bullet (shot) in the shoulder.

Root Word: Hindi 'golī' + Urdu 'lagnā'.

Synonyms: گولی کا نشانہ بننا

Translations:
EN: to be injured / to be wounded / to be hurt
AR: جُرِحَ / أُصِيبَ
FR: être blessé / être blessé de guerre

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the state of receiving physical harm to the body.

Example: حادثے میں کئی لوگ زخمی ہوئے۔

Translation: Many people were injured in the accident.

Root Word: Persian 'zakhmī' + Urdu 'honā'.

Synonyms: چوٹ لگنا, گھائل ہونا

Translations:
EN: to pass away / to breathe one's last / to die
AR: لَفَظَ أَنْفَاسَه الأَخِيرَة / مَاتَ
FR: rendre le dernier soupir / s'éteindre

Definition:
(EN) Idiomatic compound verb literally meaning to break the breath; used as a respectful way to say someone has died.

Example: وہ ہسپتال پہنچتے ہی دم توڑ گیا۔

Translation: He breathed his last (passed away) as soon as he reached the hospital.

Root Word: Persian 'dam' + Urdu 'toṛnā'.

Synonyms: انتقال کرنا, وفات پانا

Translations:
EN: to carry the funeral bier / to take out the funeral procession
AR: شَيَّعَ الجِنَازَة / حَمَلَ النَّعْش
FR: porter le cercueil / faire les funérailles

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of moving the deceased towards the burial ground.

Example: آج شام ان کا جنازہ اٹھایا جائے گا۔

Translation: His funeral (bier) will be carried this evening.

Root Word: Arabic 'janāza' + Urdu 'uṭhānā'.

Synonyms: آخری سفر پر روانہ کرنا

Translations:
EN: to bury / to inter / to commit to the earth
AR: دَفَنَ
FR: enterrer / inhumer

Definition:
(EN) Formal compound verb expressing the act of placing a body in a grave.

Example: ان کی تدفین آبائی قبرستان میں کی گئی۔

Translation: His burial (interment) was done in the ancestral graveyard.

Root Word: Arabic 'tadfeen'.

Synonyms: دفن کرنا, خاک میں چھپانا

Translations:
EN: to recite Fatiha / to pray for the deceased
AR: قَرَأَ الفَاتِحَة (عَلَى المَيْت)
FR: réciter la Fatiha / prier pour le défunt

Definition:
(EN) (Specific religious term). Reciting the opening chapter of the Quran to send spiritual reward to the dead.

Example: قبر پر جا کر فاتحہ پڑھنا سنت ہے۔

Translation: It is a Sunnah to go to the grave and recite Fatiha.

Root Word: Arabic 'fātiḥa' + Urdu 'paṛhnā'.

Synonyms: ایصالِ ثواب کرنا

Translations:
EN: to mourn / to be in grief / to observe mourning
AR: حَزِنَ / أَقَامَ الحِدَاد
FR: porter le deuil / être en deuil

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of showing sadness after a death, often by wearing specific clothes or avoiding celebrations.

Example: پورے ملک میں تین دن کا سوگ منایا گیا۔

Translation: Three days of mourning was observed throughout the country.

Root Word: Sanskrit 'soka' + Urdu 'manānā'.

Synonyms: غم کرنا, ماتم کرنا

Translations:
EN: to condole / to express sympathy / to offer condolences
AR: عَزَّى / قَدَّمَ التَّعَازِي
FR: présenter ses condoléances

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of visiting the family of the deceased to share their grief.

Example: وہ اپنے دوست سے تعزیت کرنے گیا۔

Translation: He went to condole (express sympathy) with his friend.

Root Word: Arabic 'taʿziyat'.

Synonyms: پرسہ دینا, ماتم پرسی کرنا

Translations:
EN: to pray for someone's well-being / to give a blessing
AR: دَعَا لَهُ بِالخَيْر
FR: prier pour le bien de quelqu'un

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of asking God for good things, health, or success for another person.

Example: بزرگوں سے دعائے خیر کروایا کرو۔

Translation: Always ask the elders to pray for (your) well-being.

Root Word: Arabic 'duʿā' + 'khair'.

Synonyms: دعا دینا, نیک تمنائیں رکھنا

Translations:
EN: to present an offering / to give a tribute / to gift (to a superior)
AR: قَدَّمَ قُرْبَانًا / تَقْدِمَة

Example: مظلوم کب تک ظلم سہتا رہے گا؟

Translation: How long will the oppressed person keep suffering oppression (cruelty)?

Root Word: Arabic 'ẓulm' + Urdu 'sahnā'.

Synonyms: ستم سہنا, دکھ جھیلنا

Translations:
EN: to take a petition / to cry for help (to authority) / to seek redress
AR: رَفَعَ شَكْوَاه / اِسْتَغَاثَ
FR: porter une pétition / appeler à l'aide / demander réparation

Definition:
(EN) Idiomatic compound verb expressing the act of going to a king, a judge, or God to ask for help against an injustice.

Example: وہ بادشاہ کے پاس فریاد لے گیا۔

Translation: He took a petition (cry for help) to the king.

Root Word: Persian 'faryād' + Urdu 'le jānā'.

Synonyms: نالِش کرنا, دہائی دینا

Translations:
EN: to get justice / to be treated fairly / to receive a fair verdict
AR: نَالَ حَقَّهُ / أُنْصِفَ
FR: obtenir justice / être traité équitablement

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of successfully receiving what is right and fair through a legal or moral process.

Example: آخرکار غریب کو انصاف مل گیا۔

Translation: Finally, the poor man got justice.

Root Word: Arabic 'inṣāf' + Urdu 'pānā'.

Synonyms: حق ملنا, داد رسی ہونا

Translations:
EN: to get one's right / to receive what is due / to be entitled
AR: نَالَ الحَقّ / اِسْتَحَقَّ
FR: obtenir son droit / recevoir ce qui est dû

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of receiving a share, a property, or a status that belongs to you by law or nature.

Example: ہر انسان کو اس کا حق ملنا چاہیے۔

Translation: Every human should get their right.

Root Word: Arabic 'ḥaq' + Urdu 'milnā'.

Synonyms: حصہ ملنا, واجبی ملنا

Translations:
EN: to usurp a right / to deprive / to cheat someone out of their due
AR: غَصَبَ الحَقّ / هَضَمَ الحَقّ
FR: usurper un droit / léser / frustrer quelqu'un de son dû

Definition:
(EN) Idiomatic compound verb expressing the act of taking away or refusing to give someone what they legally or morally deserve.

Example: کسی یتیم کا حق مارنا گناہ ہے۔

Translation: To usurp the right (deprive) of an orphan is a sin.

Root Word: Arabic 'ḥaq' + Urdu 'mārnā'.

Synonyms: غصب کرنا, حق دبانا

Translations:
EN: to steal / to commit theft / to pilfer
AR: سَرَقَ / اِخْتَلَسَ
FR: voler / dérober / chiper

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of taking something that belongs to someone else without their permission and with the intent to keep it.

Example: چوری کرنا ایک سماجی برائی ہے۔

Translation: To steal (commit theft) is a social evil.

Root Word: Sanskrit 'chaura' (thief) + Urdu 'karnā'.

Synonyms: سرقہ کرنا, چرانا

Translations:
EN: to rob / to commit dacoity / to raid / to plunder (violently)
AR: سَطَا عَلَى / نَهَبَ بِالقُوَّة
FR: braquer / piller / commettre un vol à main armée

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of stealing from a bank, a house, or a group by using weapons and threats.

Example: ڈاکوؤں نے بینک پر ڈاکہ ڈالا۔

Translation: The dacoits (robbers) robbed the bank.

Root Word: Urdu 'ḍāka' + 'ḍālnā'.

Synonyms: لوٹنا, چھاپہ مارنا

Translations:
EN: to loot / to plunder / to pillage / to sack (a city)
AR: نَهَبَ وَسَلَبَ / عَاثَ فَسَادًا
FR: piller / mettre à sac / saccager

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of stealing many things and causing destruction, usually during a war, a riot, or a disaster.

Example: ہجوم نے دکانوں میں لوٹ مار کی۔

Translation: The crowd looted (plundered) the shops.

Root Word: Sanskrit 'loot' + 'mār'.

Synonyms: غارت گری کرنا, چھیننا

Translations:
EN: to massacre and plunder / to engage in carnage / to lay waste
AR: قَتَلَ وَنَهَبَ / جَزَرَ
FR: massacrer et piller / commettre un carnage

Definition:
(EN) Formal compound verb expressing the act of killing many people and stealing their property simultaneously, often in an army raid.

Example: حملہ آوروں نے شہر میں قتل و غارت کی۔

Translation: The invaders engaged in massacre and plunder (carnage) in the city.

Root Word: Arabic 'qatl' + 'ghārat'.

Synonyms: خون خرابہ کرنا, اجاڑنا

Translations:
EN: to shed blood / to kill / to cause violence
AR: سَفَكَ الدِّمَاء / أَرَاقَ الدَّم
FR: verser le sang / tuer / commettre des violences

Definition:
(EN) Idiomatic compound verb expressing the act of causing injury or death to many people, leading to physical bloodshed.

Example: اقتدار کے لیے معصوموں کا خون نہ بہاؤ۔

Translation: Do not shed the blood of innocents for power.

Root Word: Persian 'khoon' + Urdu 'bahānā'.

Synonyms: خونریزی کرنا, ہلاک کرنا

Translations:
EN: to make peace / to reconcile / to compromise / to settle a dispute
AR: صَالَحَ / تَصَالَحَ
FR: faire la paix / se réconcilier / faire un compromis

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of ending an argument or a war and agreeing to live in friendship again.

Example: دونوں بھائیوں نے آپس میں صلح کر لی۔

Translation: The two brothers made peace (reconciled) with each other.

Root Word: Arabic 'ṣulaḥ'.

Synonyms: راضی ہونا, سمجھوتہ کرنا

Translations:
EN: to show enmity / to be hostile / to act like an enemy / to oppose
AR: عادى / نَاصَبَ العَدَاء
FR: faire preuve d'inimitié / être hostile / agir en ennemi

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of treating someone as an enemy and working against their interests.

Example: بلاوجہ کسی سے دشمنی کرنا اچھی بات نہیں۔

Translation: It is not a good thing to show enmity (be hostile) toward anyone without reason.

Root Word: Persian 'dushman' + Urdu 'karnā'.

Synonyms: بیر رکھنا, عداوت کرنا

Translations:
EN: to bear a grudge / to harbor enmity / to have a long-standing feud
AR: حَقَدَ عَلَى / أَضْمَرَ العَدَاء
FR: garder rancune / nourrir de l'inimitié

Definition:
(EN) Idiomatic compound verb expressing the state of keeping an old anger or hatred in the heart for a long time.

Example: دل میں کسی کے لیے بیر رکھنا گناہ ہے۔

Translation: To bear a grudge (harbor enmity) in the heart for anyone is a sin.

Root Word: Sanskrit 'vaira'.

Synonyms: کینہ رکھنا, عداوت رکھنا

Translations:
EN: to be jealous / to envy / to feel malice (at someone's success)
AR: حَسَدَ / غَارَ مِنْ
FR: être jaloux / envier / éprouver de la malice

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of feeling unhappy or angry because someone else has something good and wishing they didn't have it.

Example: دوسروں کی کامیابی پر حسد نہ کرو۔

Translation: Do not be jealous (envy) of others' success.

Root Word: Arabic 'ḥasad'.

Synonyms: جلنا, کڑھنا

Translations:
EN: to admire / to feel enviable / to feel positive envy / to emulate
AR: غَبَطَ / أُعْجِبَ بِـ
FR: admirer / envier (positivement) / s'émerveiller

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing a positive form of envy where you admire someone's good quality and wish to have it yourself without wanting them to lose it.

Example: اس کی ذہانت پر سب رشک کرتے ہیں۔

Translation: Everyone admires (feels enviable of) his intelligence.

Root Word: Persian 'rashk'.

Synonyms: فخر کرنا, دیکھ کر خوش ہونا

Translations:
EN: to emulate / to equal / to rival / to match / to claim equality
AR: ضَاهَى / سَاوَى / جَارَى
FR: égaler / rivaliser / s'égaler à / faire le poids

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of trying to be as good as someone else or claiming to have the same status as them.

Example: تم اس کی برابری نہیں کر سکتے۔

Translation: You cannot equal (match) him.

Root Word: Persian 'barābar' + Urdu 'karnā'.

Synonyms: ہمسری کرنا, مقابلہ کرنا

Translations:
EN: to vie / to cope with / to match / to be a contemporary / to rival
AR: نَافَسَ / جَارَى / بَارَى
FR: rivaliser / faire face / être à la hauteur / s'égaler

Definition:
(EN) Formal compound verb expressing the act of competing with someone of equal rank or trying to reach their level.

Example: کوئی اس کے فن کی ہمسری نہیں کر سکتا۔

Translation: No one can match (rival) his art.

Root Word: Persian 'ham' (same) + 'sar' (head).

Synonyms: برابری کرنا, ہم پلہ ہونا

Translations:
EN: to imitate / to follow (blindly) / to copy / to mimic
AR: قَلَّدَ / اِحْتَذَى بِـ
FR: imiter / suivre (aveuglément) / copier / singer

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of following someone's example, fashion, or religious school of thought, sometimes without thinking.

Example: مغربی تہذیب کی اندھی تقلید نہ کرو۔

Translation: Do not follow (imitate) Western civilization blindly.

Root Word: Arabic 'taqleed'.

Synonyms: نقل کرنا, پیروی کرنا

Translations:
EN: to follow / to pursue / to prosecute / to adhere to
AR: اِتَّبَعَ / اِقْتَفَى / وَاصَلَ
FR: suivre / poursuivre / adhérer à

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of following a leader, a path, or a legal case with dedication and purpose.

Example: ہمیں قانون کی پیروی کرنی چاہیے۔

Translation: We should follow (adhere to) the law.

Root Word: Persian 'pairvī'.

Synonyms: پیچھے چلنا, اطاعت کرنا

Translations:
EN: to obey / to submit / to yield / to be subservient
AR: أَطَاعَ / اِنْصَاعَ
FR: obéir / se soumettre / céder / être asservi

Definition:
(EN) Formal compound verb expressing the act of doing what a ruler, parent, or God asks of you with respect.

Example: والدین کی اطاعت فرض ہے۔

Translation: Obedience (submitting) to parents is a duty.

Root Word: Arabic 'iṭāʿat'.

Synonyms: فرمانبرداری کرنا, کہنا ماننا

Translations:
EN: to be obedient / to serve faithfully / to comply
AR: بَرَّ / خَدَمَ بِإِخْلَاص / اِمْتَثَلَ
FR: être obéissant / servir fidèlement / se conformer

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the quality of being a faithful and obedient person to an authority.

Example: وہ اپنے استاد کی بہت فرمانبرداری کرتا ہے۔

Translation: He is very obedient (serves faithfully) to his teacher.

Root Word: Persian 'farmān' (order) + 'bardār' (carrier).

Synonyms: اطاعت کرنا, خدمت کرنا

Translations:
EN: to obey a command / to carry out orders / to comply
AR: اِمْتَثَلَ لِلأَمْر / أَطَاعَ الحُكْم
FR: obéir à un ordre / exécuter les ordres / se conformer

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of listening to a specific order and doing exactly what is told.

Example: سپاہی نے افسر کا حکم مانا۔

Translation: The soldier obeyed the command (carried out orders) of the officer.

Root Word: Arabic 'ḥukm' + Urdu 'mānnā'.

Synonyms: تعمیل کرنا, اطاعت کرنا

Translations:
EN: to disobey / to rebel / to turn the head away / to defy
AR: عَصَى / تَمَرَّدَ / أَعْرَضَ
FR: désobéir / se rebeller / braver / défier

Definition:
(EN) Formal compound verb expressing the act of refusing to follow an order or turning away from an authority in defiance.

Example: حکم کی سرتابی کی سزا موت ہے۔

Translation: The punishment for disobeying (defying) the order is death.

Root Word: Persian 'sar' (head) + 'tābī' (turning).

Synonyms: نافرمانی کرنا, انکار کرنا

Translations:
EN: to turn the face away / to desert / to abandon / to neglect
AR: أَعْرَضَ عَنْ / تَوَلَّى / هَجَرَ
FR: se détourner / déserter / abandonner / négliger

Definition:
(EN) Idiomatic compound verb expressing the act of turning one's back on a duty, a friend, or a truth.

Example: اپنے وعدے سے روگردانی نہ کرو۔

Translation: Do not turn your face away (abandon) from your promise.

Root Word: Persian 'roo' (face) + 'gardānī' (turning).

Synonyms: منہ پھیرنا, بے وفائی کرنا

Translations:
EN: to revolt / to rebel / to mutiny / to rise up against
AR: تَمَرَّدَ / ثَارَ / خَرَجَ عَلَى
FR: se révolter / se rebeller / se mutiner / se soulever contre

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of organized and forceful opposition to a government or an authority.

Example: فوج نے بادشاہ کے خلاف بغاوت کر دی۔

Translation: The army revolted (rebelled) against the king.

Root Word: Arabic 'baghāwat'.

Synonyms: غدر مچانا, سرکشی کرنا

Translations:
EN: to betray / to commit treason / to be treacherous / to double-cross
AR: خَانَ / غَدَرَ
FR: trahir / commettre une trahison / être perfide

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of being disloyal to one's country, friend, or master by helping their enemy.

Example: وطن سے غداری کرنے والا کبھی خوش نہیں رہتا۔

Translation: One who betrays (commits treason against) the homeland never remains happy.

Root Word: Arabic 'ghadārī'.

Synonyms: بے وفائی کرنا, نمک حرامی کرنا

Translations:
EN: to be loyal / to show fidelity / to remain faithful / to stand by
AR: أَخْلَصَ / وَفَى بِالعَهْد
FR: être fidèle / faire preuve de loyauté / rester dévoué

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of being true to one's promise, country, or partner, especially during difficult times.

Example: کتا اپنی وفاداری کے لیے مشہور ہے۔

Translation: The dog is famous for its loyalty (being faithful).

Root Word: Arabic 'wafā' + Persian 'dārī' + Urdu 'karnā'.

Synonyms: ساتھ نبھانا, نمک حلالی کرنا

Translations:
EN: to support / to stand by / to accompany / to join hands with
AR: سَانَدَ / عَاوَنَ / نَصَرَ
FR: soutenir / épauler / accompagner / se joindre à

Definition:
(EN) Idiomatic compound verb expressing the act of helping someone or being with them when they are in trouble or when they are doing something.

Example: مشکل وقت میں دوست کا ساتھ دینا چاہیے۔

Translation: One should support (stand by) a friend in difficult times.

Root Word: Urdu 'sāth' + 'denā'.

Synonyms: مدد کرنا, حمایت کرنا

Translations:
EN: to sacrifice / to give an offering / to immolate
AR: ضَحَّى / قَدَّمَ قُرْبَانًا
FR: sacrifier / faire une offrande / s'immoler

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of giving up something very precious (even life) for a higher cause or a religious ritual.

Example: مجاہدین ملک کے لیے جان کی قربانی دیتے ہیں۔

Translation: Mujahideen give the sacrifice (immolate) of their lives for the country.

Root Word: Arabic 'qurbānī' + Urdu 'denā'.

Synonyms: جان دینا, وار دینا

Translations:
EN: to sacrifice / to devote / to sprinkle (money/life) / to bestow
AR: بَذَلَ / ضَحَّى / نَثَرَ (المَالَ)
FR: sacrifier / consacrer / répandre / prodiguer

Definition:
(EN) Verb meaning to give something with great love and devotion, often used for throwing coins over a bride or throwing one's life for a beloved.

Example: میں تم پر اپنی جان نچھاور کر دوں گا۔

Translation: I will sacrifice (devote) my life for you.

Root Word: Sanskrit 'nichhāvara'.

Synonyms: صدقے جانا, قربان کرنا

Translations:
EN: to give alms / to give charity / to give for God's sake
AR: تَصَدَّقَ
FR: donner l'aumône / faire la charité

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb specifically used for giving money or food to the poor to please God and remove bad luck.

Example: مصیبت ٹالنے کے لیے صدقہ دو۔

Translation: Give alms (charity) to ward off trouble.

Root Word: Arabic 'ṣadqa' + Urdu 'denā'.

Synonyms: خیرات کرنا, دان کرنا

Translations:
EN: to give to charity / to distribute alms / to donate
AR: زَكَّى / أَعْطَى الخَيْرَات
FR: faire la charité / distribuer des aumônes / donner

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of giving money, clothes, or food to the needy as an act of goodness.

Example: وہ اپنی دولت غریبوں میں خیرات کرتا ہے۔

Translation: He distributes his wealth in charity among the poor.

Root Word: Arabic 'khairāt'.

Synonyms: صدقہ کرنا, بانٹنا

Translations:
EN: to assist / to help / to aid / to cooperate
AR: أَعَانَ / عَاوَنَ / سَاعَدَ
FR: assister / aider / seconder / coopérer

Definition:
(EN) Formal compound verb expressing the act of providing support, especially financial or physical, for a project or a person.

Example: اس مہم میں ہماری اعانت کریں۔

Translation: Please assist (aid) us in this campaign.

Root Word: Arabic 'iʿānat'.

Synonyms: مدد کرنا, تعاون کرنا

Translations:
EN: to help / to support / to take someone by the hand / to patronize
AR: أَخَذَ بِيَدِهِ / سَانَدَ
FR: secourir / soutenir / tendre la main / patronner

Definition:
(EN) Poetic and formal compound verb meaning to help someone who is falling or in a very miserable state.

Example: یتیموں کی دستگیری کرنا عظیم کام ہے۔

Translation: To help (support) orphans is a great deed.

Root Word: Persian 'dast' (hand) + 'geerī' (holding).

Synonyms: سہارا دینا, مدد کرنا

Translations:
EN: to patronize / to sponsor / to supervise / to act as a guardian
AR: رَعَى / أَشْرَفَ عَلَى / وَلِيَ
FR: patronner / parrainer / superviser / agir en tuteur

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of looking after a project, a person, or a family as a leader or protector.

Example: آپ اس ادارے کی سرپرستی قبول فرمائیں۔

Translation: Please accept the patronage (supervision) of this institution.

Root Word: Persian 'sar' (head) + 'parast' (worshipper/devotee).

Synonyms: نگرانی کرنا, کفالت کرنا

Translations:
EN: to monitor / to supervise / to watch over / to oversee
AR: رَاقَبَ / أَشْرَفَ / نَظَرَ فِي
FR: surveiller / superviser / veiller sur / contrôler

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of carefully watching a person or a process to make sure everything is done correctly.

Example: امتحان کے دوران اساتذہ نگرانی کرتے ہیں۔

Translation: Teachers supervise (monitor) during the exam.

Root Word: Persian 'nigrānī'.

Synonyms: دیکھ بھال کرنا, چوکسی کرنا

Translations:
EN: to preserve / to protect / to guard / to maintain
AR: صَانَ / حَفِظَ / وَقَى
FR: préserver / protéger / garder / maintenir

Definition:
(EN) Highly formal compound verb expressing the act of keeping something safe from decay, damage, or attack.

Example: آثارِ قدیمہ کی صیانت ضروری ہے۔

Translation: The preservation (protection) of ancient ruins is necessary.

Root Word: Arabic 'ṣiyānat'.

Synonyms: حفاظت کرنا, بچانا

Translations:
EN: to look after / to care for / to tend / to maintain
AR: اِعْتَنَى بِـ / رَعَى
FR: s'occuper de / soigner / entretenir / prendre soin de

Definition:
(EN) Idiomatic compound verb expressing the daily act of taking care of a child, an elderly person, a garden, or a house.

Example: وہ اپنے بوڑھے والدین کی دیکھ بھال کرتا ہے۔

Translation: He looks after (cares for) his elderly parents.

Root Word: Urdu 'dekh' (see) + 'bhāl' (search/care).

Synonyms: توجہ دینا, خبر گیری کرنا

Translations:
EN: to nourish / to bring up / to nurture / to foster
AR: رَبَّى / غَذَّى
FR: nourrir / élever / cultiver / favoriser

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of providing food and education to a child or a plant so they can grow properly.

Example: اس کی پرورش اچھے ماحول میں ہوئی۔

Translation: His upbringing (nurturing) happened in a good environment.

Root Word: Persian 'parvarish'.

Synonyms: پالنا پوسنا, تربیت کرنا

Translations:
EN: to train / to educate / to discipline / to groom
AR: رَبَّى / دَرَّبَ / هَذَّبَ
FR: former / éduquer / discipliner / préparer

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of teaching someone skills, manners, or a specific way of behaving.

Example: بچوں کی اخلاقی تربیت بہت ضروری ہے۔

Translation: Moral training (discipline) of children is very important.

Root Word: Arabic 'tarbiyat'.

Synonyms: سکھانا, ادب سکھانا

Translations:
EN: to lecture / to teach / to give a lesson / to preach
AR: أَلْقَى دَرْسًا / وَعَظَ
FR: donner un cours / enseigner / donner une leçon / prêcher

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of standing before a group and explaining a religious, moral, or academic topic.

Example: امام صاحب نے جمعہ کو بہترین درس دیا۔

Translation: The Imam gave an excellent lecture (lesson) on Friday.

Root Word: Arabic 'dars' + Urdu 'denā'.

Synonyms: سبق دینا, وعظ کرنا

Translations:
EN: to preach / to sermonize / to give a religious discourse
AR: وَعَظَ / أَلْقَى خُطْبَة
FR: prêcher / sermonner / donner un discours religieux

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb expressing the act of giving a formal religious or moral speech to an audience to guide them.

Example: صدر نے نئے وزیر کو نامزد کر دیا۔

Translations:
EN: to support / to second / to endorse / to confirm

FR: soutenir / appuyer / endosser / confirmer

Definition:
(EN) Formal compound verb meaning to agree with someone else's suggestion or to state publicly that you support a specific idea or person.

Example: میں آپ کی تجویز کی تائید کرتا ہوں۔

Synonyms: حمایت کرنا, ساتھ دینا

FR: soutenir / préconiser / défendre / prendre parti pour

(EN) Compound verb meaning to stand with someone and help them by speaking or acting in their favor, especially when they are facing a difficulty.

(EN) Formal compound verb meaning to publicly show that you disagree with an action or a law, often by walking in the streets or by writing a letter of objection.

(EN) Compound verb meaning to fight against a government, a leader, or an authority because you think they are unfair or because you want to take power.

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb meaning to secretly watch a person or a country to find out their hidden plans or information for an enemy.

(EN) Compound verb meaning to watch a process, a person, or a place carefully to make sure that everything is being done correctly and safely.

Translation: The teacher is supervising (monitoring) the students' exam.

Root Word: Persian 'nigrānī' + Urdu 'karnā'.

EN: to guard / to keep watch / to patrol / to stand sentry

FR: garder / veiller / patrouiller / monter la garde

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb meaning to stand at a gate or walk around a building at night to protect it from thieves or enemies.

FR: défendre / protéger / justifier / plaider pour

Translation: We know how to defend (protect) our country.

Root Word: Arabic 'difāʿ' + Urdu 'karnā'.

Root Word: Arabic 'muqābala' + Urdu 'karnā'.

Translations:
EN: to battle / to fight in war (poetic/formal) / to engage in combat

(EN) High poetic and archaic compound verb meaning to participate in a great battle or a field of war.

Translation: The brave fought (battled) well in the field.

Root Word: Persian 'kārzār' + Urdu 'karnā'.

Synonyms: جنگ کرنا, لڑائی کرنا

Translations:
EN: to make peace / to reconcile / to make a truce / to patch up

FR: faire la paix / se réconcilier / faire une trêve / se raccommoder

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb meaning to stop fighting and become friends again after a war, a legal case, or a personal fight.

Example: دونوں قبیلوں نے آپس میں صلح کر لی۔

Translation: Both tribes made peace (reconciled) among themselves.

Root Word: Arabic 'ṣulḥ' + Urdu 'karnā'.

Synonyms: سمجھوتہ کرنا, راضی نامہ کرنا

Translations:
EN: to make an agreement / to sign a treaty / to contract / to pact

Translations:

FR: signer / autographier / souscrire / endosser

Example: اس نے دستاویز پر دستخط کر دیے۔

Translation: He signed (endorsed) the document.

Root Word: Persian 'dast' (hand) + Arabic 'khaṭ' (writing) + Urdu 'karnā'.

Synonyms: لکھنا (rare), تائید کرنا

Translations:
EN: to seal / to stamp / to validate / to confirm (officially)

(EN) Verb meaning to put a physical ink stamp or wax seal on a paper to show that it is official and cannot be changed.

Translation: The officer's seal (stamp) is on the file.

Root Word: Persian 'mohr' + Urdu 'lagānā'.

Synonyms: ٹھپہ لگانا, پکا کرنا

Translations:
EN: to verify / to confirm / to attest / to certify
AR: صَدَّقَ / أَثْبَتَ / حَقَّقَ
FR: vérifier / confirmer / attester / certifier

(EN) Formal compound verb meaning to check a fact or a document and state officially that it is true and accurate.

Example: پولیس نے اس کی خبر کی تصدیق کی۔

Translation: The police verified (confirmed) his news.

Root Word: Arabic 'taṣdeeq' + Urdu 'karnā'.

Synonyms: سچ بتانا, ثبوت دینا

Translations:
EN: to deny / to refute / to contradict / to disprove
AR: نَفَى / كَذَّبَ / فَـنَّـدَ / رَدَّ
FR: nier / réfuter / contredire / désapprouver

Example: ترجمان نے جھوٹی خبروں کی تردید کی۔

Translation: The spokesperson denied (refuted) the false news.

Root Word: Arabic 'tardeed' + Urdu 'karnā'.

Synonyms: انکار کرنا, غلط ثابت کرنا

Translations:
EN: to be denied / to be refuted / to be contradicted
AR: اِنْتَفَى / كُذِّبَ / نُفِيَ
FR: être nié / être réfuté / être contredit

(EN) Passive compound verb meaning for a statement or a rumor to be proven false by someone else or by facts.

Example: عدالتی فیصلے سے اس کے دعوے کی تردید ہو گئی۔

Translation: His claim was refuted (denied) by the court decision.

Root Word: Arabic 'tardeed' + Urdu 'honā'.

Synonyms: جھوٹا ثابت ہونا, نفی ہونا

Translations:
EN: to turn away / to deviate / to defy / to disregard
AR: أَعْرَضَ عَن / نَكَثَ / خَالَفَ
FR: se détourner / s'écarter / défier / ignorer

Example: قانون سے روگردانی کرنا جرم ہے۔

Translation: It is a crime to defy (turn away from) the law.

Root Word: Persian 'ru' (face) + 'gardānī' (turning) + Urdu 'karnā'.

Translations:
EN: to confess / to admit / to promise / to declare
AR: أَقَرَّ / اِعْتَرَفَ / وَعَدَ / صَرَّحَ
FR: confesser / admettre / promettre / déclarer

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb meaning to openly state that you have done something (good or bad) or to make a serious promise to do something.

Example: اس نے سچ بولنے کا اقرار کیا۔

Translation: He confessed (promised) to speak the truth.

Root Word: Arabic 'iqrār' + Urdu 'karnā'.

EN: to confess to a crime / to plead guilty / to admit a fault
AR: اِعْتَرَفَ بِالجَرِيمَة / أَقَرَّ بِذَنْبِه
FR: avouer un crime / plaider coupable / admettre une faute

Definition:

Example: ملزم نے عدالت میں اقرارِ جرم کر لیا۔

Translation: The accused confessed to the crime (pleaded guilty) in court.

Root Word: Arabic 'iqrār' + 'jurm' + Urdu 'karnā'.

Synonyms: گناہ ماننا, اعتراف کرنا

Translations:
EN: to get punishment / to be punished / to suffer the consequences
AR: عُوقِبَ / نَالَ جَزَاءَهُ
FR: être puni / être sanctionné / subir les conséquences

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb meaning to receive a penalty (like jail or a fine) for a mistake or a crime that you committed.

Example: قاتل کو ضرور سزا پانی چاہیے۔

Translation: The killer must get punishment (be punished).

Root Word: Persian 'sazā' + Urdu 'pānā'.

Synonyms: سزا ملنا, بھگتنا

Translations:
EN: to punish / to penalize / to sentence / to discipline

FR: punir / pénaliser / condamner / discipliner

(EN) Compound verb meaning for a judge, a parent, or God to give a penalty to someone for their bad actions.

Example: جج نے چور کو دو سال قید کی سزا دی۔

Translation: The judge punished (sentenced) the thief to two years in prison.

Root Word: Persian 'sazā' + Urdu 'denā'.

Synonyms: تعزیر کرنا, گوشمالی کرنا

Translations:
EN: to get reward / to get retribution (divine/formal) / to be compensated

FR: être récompensé / obtenir une rétribution (divine/formelle) / être compensé

Definition:

Example: صبر کرنے والوں کو ضرور جزا ملتی ہے۔

Translation: Those who have patience definitely get a reward (retribution).

Root Word: Arabic 'jazā' + Urdu 'milnā'.

Synonyms: ثواب ملنا, صلہ ملنا

Translations:
EN: to be retribution / to be karma (poetic/formal) / to get what one deserves
AR: كَانَ جَزَاءً وِفَاقًا / نَالَ مَا اِسْتَحَقَّ
FR: être une rétribution / être le karma (poétique/formel) / récolter ce qu'on a semé

Definition:
(EN) High poetic and philosophical idiom meaning for the consequences of your own actions to come back to you, whether good or bad.

Example: جو بوؤ گے وہی کاٹو گے، یہی مکافاتِ عمل ہے۔

Translation: You reap what you sow, this is the retribution (karma).

Root Word: Arabic 'mukāfāt' + 'ʿamal' + Urdu 'honā'.

Synonyms: بدلہ ملنا, انجام ہونا

EN: to take a lesson / to take a warning / to learn from a bad example

FR: tirer une leçon / prendre un avertissement / apprendre d'un mauvais exemple

Definition:
(EN) Formal compound verb meaning to see someone else's failure or punishment and learn to never make the same mistake yourself.

Example: ہمیں تاریخ سے عبرت حاصل کرنی چاہیے۔

Translation: We should take a lesson (warning) from history.

Root Word: Arabic 'ʿibrat' + Urdu 'ḥāṣil karnā'.

Synonyms: سبق سیکھنا, نصیحت پکڑنا

Translations:
EN: to learn a lesson / to gain experience / to understand a point
AR: تَعَلَّمَ دَرْسًا / اِسْتَفَادَ مِنْ تَجْرِبَة
FR: apprendre une leçon / acquérir de l'expérience / comprendre un point

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb meaning to understand a truth or a moral rule because of a personal experience, often a painful one.

Example: میں نے اپنی ناکامی سے بہت بڑا سبق سیکھا۔

Translation: I learned a very big lesson from my failure.

Root Word: Arabic 'sabaq' + Urdu 'seekhnā'.

Synonyms: عبرت حاصل کرنا, سمجھ آنا

Translations:
EN: to advise / to preach / to admonish / to counsel

FR: conseiller / prêcher / admonester / conseiller

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb meaning to give good moral advice to a younger person or a friend to help them live a better life.

Example: بزرگوں کو چاہیے کہ بچوں کو نصیحت کریں۔

Translation: Elders should advise (preach to) the children.

Root Word: Arabic 'naṣīḥat' + Urdu 'karnā'.

Synonyms: ہدایت کرنا, پند کہنا

Translations:
EN: to preach / to propagate (religion/ideology) / to proselytize / to mission
AR: بَلَّغَ / نَشَرَ الدِّين / دَعَا إِلَى
FR: prêcher / propager (religion/idéologie) / prosélytisme / faire mission

Definition:
(EN) Formal compound verb meaning to travel and talk to people to spread a religious message or a specific political idea to convert them.

Example: وہ افریقہ میں دین کی تبلیغ کر رہے ہیں۔

Translation: They are preaching (propagating) the religion in Africa.

Root Word: Arabic 'tablīgh' + Urdu 'karnā'.

Synonyms: دعوت دینا, پیغام پہنچانا

Translations:
EN: to issue a religious decree / to rule (religiously) / to give a formal opinion
AR: أَفْتَى / أَصْدَرَ فَتْوَى
FR: émettre un décret religieux / statuer (religieusement) / donner un avis formel

Definition:
(EN) Formal compound verb meaning for a religious scholar (Mufti) to give an official answer to a legal question according to Islamic law.

Example: مفتی صاحب نے اس مسئلے پر فتویٰ دے دیا۔

Translation: The Mufti issued a religious decree (ruled) on this issue.

Root Word: Arabic 'fatwa' + Urdu 'denā'.

Synonyms: حکم سنانا, مسئلہ بتانا

Translations:
EN: to preach / to deliver a sermon / to lecture (morally) / to exhort
AR: وَعَظَ / أَلْقَى خُطْبَة / أَرْشَدَ
FR: prêcher / prononcer un sermon / donner une conférence (morale) / exhorter

Definition:
(EN) High formal compound verb meaning to stand in front of a crowd in a mosque or a meeting and give a speech about God, morality, and afterlife.

Example: خطیب صاحب نے مسجد میں پر اثر وعظ کیا۔

Translation: The orator delivered an effective sermon (preached) in the mosque.

Root Word: Arabic 'vaʿẓ' + Urdu 'karnā'.

Synonyms: خطبہ دینا, نصیحت کرنا

Translations:
EN: to call for prayer / to announce / to proclaim / to summon (religiously)
AR: أَذَّنَ / رَفَعَ الأَذَان / نَادَى لِلصَّلَاة
FR: appeler à la prière / annoncer / proclamer / convoquer (religieusement)

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb meaning to make the loud official announcement from a mosque that it is time for Muslims to come and pray.

Example: موذن نے مسجد میں اذان دی۔

Translation: The muezzin gave the call for prayer (announced) in the mosque.

Root Word: Arabic 'adhān' + Urdu 'denā'.

Synonyms: پکارنا, آواز دینا

Translations:
EN: to pray (canonical prayer) / to perform worship / to prostrate
AR: صَلَّى / أَدَّى الصَّلَاة
FR: prier (prière canonique) / accomplir l'adoration / se prosterner

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb meaning to perform the five daily structured prayers that are mandatory in Islam, involving standing, bowing, and prostrating.

Example: وہ وقت پر نماز پڑھتا ہے۔

(EN) Compound verb phrase meaning to willingly die or undergo extreme suffering for the sake of one's country, religion, or a loved one.

FR: se battre / se quereller / batailler / contester

(EN) Compound verb phrase meaning to use physical force or angry words against someone because of a disagreement or a war.

Translations:
EN: to make peace / to reconcile / to compromise / to settle a dispute
AR: تَصَالَحَ / صَالَحَ / تَهَادَنَ / سَوَّى الخِلاف
FR: faire la paix / se réconcilier / faire un compromis / régler un différend

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb phrase meaning to end a fight or a disagreement and start being friendly or cooperative again.

Example: ان دونوں قبیلوں نے آپس میں صلح کر لی۔

Translation: These two tribes made peace (reconciled) with each other.

Root Word: Arabic 'ṣulḥ' + Urdu 'karnā'.

Translations:
EN: to forgive / to pardon / to excuse / to remit (sin/debt)

FR: pardonner / gracier / excuser / remettre (péché/dette)

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb phrase meaning to stop feeling angry or wanting to punish someone for a mistake or a crime they committed.

Example: غلطی کرنے والے کو معاف کرنا بڑائی کی نشانی ہے۔

Translation: Forgiving (pardoning) the one who makes a mistake is a sign of greatness.

Synonyms: درگزر کرنا, بخش دینا

EN: to turn towards God / to repent (highly formal/spiritual) / to return / to seek refuge

FR: se tourner vers Dieu / se repentir (très formel/spirituel) / retourner / chercher refuge

Definition:
(EN) Highly formal and spiritual compound verb meaning to turn one's heart sincerely toward the Divine, seeking forgiveness and guidance after going astray.

Example: سچے دل سے انابت کرنا ہی نجات کا راستہ ہے۔

Translation: Turning towards God (repenting) with a sincere heart is the path to salvation.

Root Word: Arabic 'inābat' + Urdu 'karnā'.

Synonyms: توبہ کرنا, رجوع لانا

Translations:
EN: to worship / to pray / to serve (God) / to adore

FR: adorer / prier / servir (Dieu) / vénérer

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb meaning to perform religious acts and show total devotion to a deity.

Example: وہ رات بھر اللہ کی عبادت کرتا ہے۔

Translation: He worships (serves God) the whole night.

Root Word: Arabic 'ʿibādat' + Urdu 'karnā'.

Synonyms: پوجا کرنا, بندگی کرنا

EN: to pray / to supplicate / to ask God / to invoke blessings

FR: prier / supplier / demander à Dieu / invoquer des bénédictions

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb phrase meaning to speak to God to ask for something or to seek help for yourself or others.

Example: ہمیں دوسروں کی بھلائی کے لیے بھی دعا مانگنی چاہیے۔

Translation: We should also pray (supplicate) for the welfare of others.

Root Word: Arabic 'duʿā' + Hindi 'māngnā'.

Synonyms: التجاء کرنا, مناجات کرنا

Translations:
EN: to give thanks / to be grateful / to appreciate / to acknowledge a favor

FR: rendre grâce / être reconnaissant / apprécier / reconnaître une faveur

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb phrase meaning to express gratitude for a blessing, a gift, or help received from God or a person.

Example: ہر حال میں اللہ کا شکر کرنا چاہیے۔

Translation: One should give thanks (be grateful) to Allah in every situation.

Root Word: Arabic 'shukr' + Urdu 'karnā'.

Synonyms: احسان ماننا, حمد و ثنا کرنا

Translations:
EN: to be patient / to endure / to persevere / to wait calmly

FR: être patient / endurer / persévérer / attendre calmement

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb phrase meaning to stay calm and not get angry or lose hope during a difficult or painful time.

Example: مشکل وقت میں صبر کرنا بہت بڑی صفت ہے۔

Translation: Being patient (enduring) in difficult times is a great quality.

Root Word: Arabic 'ṣabr' + Urdu 'karnā'.

Synonyms: برداشت کرنا, تحمل سے کام لینا

Translations:
EN: to work hard / to strive / to toil / to labor
AR: اِجْتَهَدَ / كَدَحَ / سَعَى بِيَقِين / شَقِيَ
FR: travailler dur / s'efforcer / peiner / travailler

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb phrase meaning to put a lot of physical or mental effort into a job or a task to achieve a result.

Example: کامیابی کے لیے محنت کرنا لازمی ہے۔

Translation: It is essential to work hard (strive) for success.

Root Word: Arabic 'meḥnat' + Urdu 'karnā'.

Synonyms: کوشش کرنا, جانفشانی کرنا

Translations:
EN: to struggle / to run about (highly formal/literary) / to strive hard / to exert effort
AR: سَعَى حَثِيثًا / كَافَحَ / نَاضَلَ / رَكَضَ بَحْثًا عَنْ
FR: lutter / courir partout (très formel/littéraire) / s'efforcer / exercer des efforts

Definition:
(EN) Highly formal and literary compound verb meaning to make repeated and energetic efforts, often involving traveling or running between places, to get a job done or solve a problem.

Example: اس نے نوکری حاصل کرنے کے لیے بہت تگ و دو کی۔

Translation: He struggled hard (ran about) a lot to get a job.

Root Word: Persian 'tag-o-dou' + Urdu 'karnā'.

Synonyms: کوشش کرنا، دوڑ دھوپ کرنا

Translations:
EN: to be successful / to succeed / to prosper / to triumph
AR: نَجَحَ / أَفْلَحَ / فَازَ / اِنْتَصَرَ
FR: réussir / prospérer / triompher / avoir du succès

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb phrase meaning to achieve a goal, to pass an exam, or to reach a high position in life.

Example: وہ اپنی محنت سے کامیاب ہو گیا۔

Translation: He became successful (succeeded) through his hard work.

Root Word: Persian 'kāmyāb' + Urdu 'honā'.

Synonyms: بامراد ہونا, فتح مند ہونا

Translations:
EN: to fail / to be unsuccessful / to fall through / to miscarry
AR: فَشَلَ / أَخْفَقَ / خَابَ / لَمْ يَنْجَحْ
FR: échouer / ne pas réussir / tomber à l'eau / faire une fausse couche

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb phrase meaning to not achieve the result you wanted or expected, or for a plan to stop working.

Example: وہ امتحان میں ناکام ہو گیا۔

Translation: He failed (was unsuccessful) in the exam.

Root Word: Persian 'nākām' + Urdu 'honā'.

Synonyms: نامراد ہونا, مات کھانا

Translations:
EN: to lose courage / to give up / to be disheartened / to yield

FR: perdre courage / abandonner / être découragé / céder

Definition:
(EN) Compound verb phrase meaning to stop trying because you feel that a situation is too difficult or that you cannot win.

Example: ہمیں کبھی ہمت نہیں ہارنی چاہیے۔

Translation: We should never lose courage (give up).

Root Word: Hindi 'himmat' + 'hārnā'.

Synonyms: مایوس ہونا, دل چھوڑ دینا

EN: to conquer / to scale (a peak) / to achieve (a difficult task) / to perform (formal)

FR: conquérir / gravir (un sommet) / accomplir (une tâche difficile) / exécuter (formel)

Definition:
(EN) Highly formal and literary compound verb meaning to successfully finish a very difficult mission, to climb a high mountain, or to defeat an enemy fortress.

Example: کوہ پیماؤں نے کے ٹو کی چوٹی سر کر لی۔

Synonyms: فتح کرنا, مکمل کرنا
